en.caption:
Be at Monte Albán at 8 and it's yours. Unpopular opinion: 2 days in Oaxaca is enough. 👇

Two days that beat the crowds: Monte Albán when it opens at 8, before the heat, and the Ethnobotanical Garden, which you can only enter on a guided tour.

Urban Tales plans your trip in a minute and tells you the story of every stop as you walk.

en.dm:
Oaxaca · 2 days
Day 1: Monte Albán at 8 a.m. → Site museum → South Platform
Day 2: Ethnobotanical Garden → Museum of Cultures → Santo Domingo → Andador Turístico → Cathedral → Zócalo → Benito Juárez Market
Tip: the Ethnobotanical Garden is guided tours only; check the times before you go.
